panels.title: Ledger Build Rate
panels.description:
**What:** How many new ledgers this node finishes building per second.
**How it's computed:** Per-second rate of completed ledger-build operations, averaged over 5 minutes and split by node.
**Reading it:** A steady flat line; the value should track the network close cadence.
**Healthy range:** About 0.2-0.3 ledgers/sec on mainnet (roughly one every 3-5s); workload-dependent on test networks.
**Watch for:** A drop toward zero (node fell out of sync or stalled) or a value well above the network rate (rebuilding history).
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/ledger/detail/BuildLedger.cpp:buildLedgerImpl

panels.title: Ledger Build Duration
panels.description:
**What:** The time taken to build a single ledger, at the 95th percentile.
**How it's computed:** 95th-percentile of ledger-build durations over a 5-minute window, per node.
**Reading it:** Lower is better; the line should stay well under the ledger interval.
**Healthy range:** Typically tens to low hundreds of milliseconds; workload-dependent.
**Watch for:** Sustained rises approaching the close interval, which indicate heavy transaction sets or disk/I/O pressure.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/ledger/detail/BuildLedger.cpp:buildLedgerImpl

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="ledger.build"}[5m])))

panels.title: Ledger Validation Rate
panels.description:
**What:** How often ledgers reach full validation (accepted by the trusted validator quorum) per second.
**How it's computed:** Per-second rate of ledger-validation events over 5 minutes, per node.
**Reading it:** Should closely match the build rate under normal, in-sync operation.
**Healthy range:** About 0.2-0.3/sec on mainnet; workload-dependent elsewhere.
**Watch for:** A validation rate that lags the build rate, signalling the node is building ahead of the network consensus it trusts.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/ledger/detail/LedgerMaster.cpp:LedgerMaster::checkAccept

panels.title: Ledger Build Duration Heatmap
panels.description:
**What:** The full distribution of ledger-build times over the window, not just a single percentile.
**How it's computed:** Counts of ledger builds falling in each duration band per 5-minute window, shown as color density.
**Reading it:** A tight low band is healthy; scattered high cells mean occasional slow builds.
**Healthy range:** Most mass concentrated in the low-millisecond bands; workload-dependent.
**Watch for:** A second cluster of hot cells at high durations (bimodal build times) hidden by percentile charts.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/ledger/detail/BuildLedger.cpp:buildLedgerImpl

panels.title: Transaction Apply Duration
panels.description:
**What:** The time spent applying the agreed transaction set into the new ledger, at the 95th percentile.
**How it's computed:** 95th-percentile of transaction-apply durations over 5 minutes, per node.
**Reading it:** Lower is better; this is a large share of total build time.
**Healthy range:** A few to tens of milliseconds; scales with transaction volume per ledger.
**Watch for:** Spikes during large or expensive transaction sets, which push out overall ledger build time.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/ledger/detail/BuildLedger.cpp:applyTransactions

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="tx.apply"}[5m])))

panels.title: Transaction Apply Rate
panels.description:
**What:** How often the transaction-apply phase runs per second (once per ledger build).
**How it's computed:** Per-second rate of transaction-apply operations over 5 minutes, per node.
**Reading it:** Should track the ledger build rate almost exactly.
**Healthy range:** About 0.2-0.3/sec on mainnet; workload-dependent.
**Watch for:** Divergence from the build rate, which would indicate a metric or pipeline anomaly.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/ledger/detail/BuildLedger.cpp:applyTransactions

panels.title: Ledger Store Rate
panels.description:
**What:** How often completed ledgers are written into ledger history per second.
**How it's computed:** Per-second rate of ledger-store operations over 5 minutes, per node.
**Reading it:** Should match the build rate during normal operation.
**Healthy range:** About 0.2-0.3/sec on mainnet; can burst higher while backfilling history.
**Watch for:** A store rate below the build rate (storage falling behind) or a stall at zero.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/ledger/detail/LedgerMaster.cpp:LedgerMaster::storeLedger

panels.title: Build vs Close Duration
panels.description:
**What:** Ledger build time compared with the total consensus ledger-close time, both at the 95th percentile.
**How it's computed:** Two 95th-percentile duration series over 5 minutes: ledger construction and the full consensus close, per node.
**Reading it:** Build should sit below close; the gap is consensus overhead outside construction.
**Healthy range:** Close a bit above build; both workload-dependent and under the round interval.
**Watch for:** A widening gap (consensus-pipeline overhead growing) or build time approaching close time.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/ledger/detail/BuildLedger.cpp:buildLedgerImpl; src/xrpld/app/consensus/RCLConsensus.cpp:RCLConsensus::Adaptor::onClose

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="ledger.build"}[5m])))
